titleJa: 心臓の鼓動が聞こえる
summary: The body in the nape is Eren. The cannons rise. He wakes enough to shield Armin and Mikasa, and Mikasa hears that his chest is still beating.

segments.ja: 蒸気が少し薄れると、うなじの中の顔が確定します。確定する顔は、エレン・イェーガーです。イェーガーを、アルミンはついに声に出します。出す声は、計画の声ではありません。友の名です。名を聞いたミカサは、屋根から降り始めます。降り始める速度は、一位の慎重さを捨てています。捨てた先で、周囲の刃と砲が同じ顔へ向きます。
segments.en: When the steam thins a little, the face inside the nape becomes certain. The face that becomes certain is Eren Jaeger. Armin finally puts Jaeger into a voice. The voice he puts it in is not the voice of the plan. It is a friend's name. Mikasa, hearing the name, begins to come down from the roof. The speed of beginning to come down has thrown away the caution of first place. Ahead of what she threw away, the surrounding blades and cannon turn toward the same face.

segments.ja: ジャンは、エレンの顔を見て足を止めます。止める頭の中で、二つの分類が衝突します。衝突の一つは、同じ飯を食った同期です。もう一つは、巨人を内側から着ていた存在です。存在を、彼はすぐに抱きしめることはできません。できないまま、彼は砲の兵に待てと言います。と言う声は、小さく、すぐに覆されます。覆す空気は、恐怖です。恐怖は、トーマスたちの死を今日見た兵の中にあります。
segments.en: Jean stops his feet when he sees Eren's face. Inside the head that stops, two classifications collide. One of the collision is a classmate who ate the same meals. The other is a being that wore a Titan from the inside. He cannot embrace the being at once. Without being able to, he tells the cannon soldiers to wait. The voice that says it is small, and it is covered at once. The air that covers it is fear. The fear is inside the soldiers who today saw the deaths of Thomas and the others.

segments.ja: 本部の近くの砲が、エレンのいるうなじへ角度を変えます。変える操作は、巨人を撃つ手順のままです。ままの手順では、隣にいる人間は考慮されません。されないアルミンが、砲とエレンのあいだに入ります。入る背中は、細いです。細い背中を、ミカサがさらに半分覆います。覆う二人は、撃てば仲間も消える、と体で示します。示す言葉は、まだ長くはありません。ない短さでも、砲の兵は指を止めます。
segments.en: A cannon near headquarters changes its angle toward the nape where Eren is. The operation of changing it stays the procedure for shooting a Titan. In the procedure left as it is, the humans beside him are not considered. Armin, not considered, steps between the cannon and Eren. The back that steps in is thin. Mikasa covers half of the thin back further. The two who cover show with their bodies that if you shoot, companions disappear too. The words that show it are not long yet. Even in that shortness, the cannon soldiers stop their fingers.

segments.ja: アルミンは、砲の前で今日の通りを短く話します。話す内容は、この体がほかの巨人だけを倒していた、です。倒していた結果、ミカサは生き、本部の道が開きました。開いた功を、彼はエレンの名に結びます。結ぶ証拠は、まだうなじから出た顔だけです。だけの証拠を、兵士は信じ切りません。信じ切らない質問は、次も人を喰うのか、です。かの問いに、アルミンは保証を出せません。
segments.en: In front of the cannon, Armin tells today's street shortly. The content he tells is that this body was bringing down only other Titans. As a result of that bringing down, Mikasa is alive, and the road to headquarters opened. He ties the merit that opened to Eren's name. The proof he ties is still only the face that came out of the nape. The soldiers do not fully believe the only proof. The question they do not fully believe is whether he will eat people next time too. Armin cannot offer a guarantee to that question.

segments.ja: エレンの意識は、口の中と、うなじの外を行き来します。行き来する目は、アルミンとミカサを捉えます。捉えるまでの時間は、長いです。長いあいだ、彼はトーマスの名前と、自分の欠けた腕を混同します。混同した口は、まだ完全な文を作りません。作らない体は、熱く、蒸気を自分の皮膚から出しています。出している熱を、ミカサは手の甲で確認します。確認する熱は、死者の冷たさではありません。ありません。
segments.en: Eren's consciousness goes back and forth between the inside of the mouth and the outside of the nape. The eyes that go back and forth catch Armin and Mikasa. The time until they catch them is long. During the long time, he mixes Thomas's name with his own missing arm. The mouth that mixed them does not yet make a complete sentence. The body that does not make one is hot, and it is putting out steam from its own skin. Mikasa confirms the heat it is putting out with the back of her hand. The heat she confirms is not the cold of a dead person. It is not.

segments.ja: 砲の上で、待て、が再び撃て、に戻ります。戻る理由は、巨人の肉がまだエレンの周りに残っている、です。残っている肉が動けば、本部が潰れる、という判断です。判断は、恐怖としては理解できます。理解できる判断が、アルミンとミカサを巻き込みます。巻き込む砲口を、二人は避けません。避けない選択は、エレンを一人にしない、です。しない背中へ、砲弾の準備が終わります。
segments.en: On the cannon, the wait returns again to shoot. The reason it returns is that Titan flesh is still left around Eren. The judgment is that if the flesh that is left moves, headquarters will be crushed. The judgment can be understood as fear. The judgment that can be understood pulls Armin and Mikasa in. The two do not dodge the cannon mouth that pulls them in. The choice not to dodge is not to leave Eren alone. Toward the backs that do not leave him, the preparation of a cannon round finishes.

segments.en: Just before the cannon spits fire, Eren's body reacts. The reaction is not a complete titanization. It is not. Part of the bone and flesh comes out like a wall in front of Armin and Mikasa. The wall that comes out receives the cannon round. With the pain of receiving it, he opens his eyes. The eyes that opened are not yet seeing the whole battlefield. Without seeing it, he says the two people's names. Saying them is the end of sleep. The shield of the end is ugly.

segments.ja: 盾の肉が崩れたあと、ミカサはエレンの胸に耳を近づけます。近づける理由は、名を言った声だけでは足りない、です。足りない確認は、胸の内側の繰り返しの音です。音が続くなら、彼は巨人の抜け殻ではなく、人として戻っています。戻っている音を、彼女はマフラーの布越しに聞きます。聞く顔を、周囲は狂気に近いと見ます。見る誤解を、彼女は説明しません。説明の代わりに、彼女はアルミンに一度うなずきます。
segments.en: After the flesh of the shield collapses, Mikasa brings an ear close to Eren's chest. The reason she brings it close is that the voice that said their names is not enough. The confirmation that is not enough is the repeated sound inside the chest. If the sound continues, he has returned as a person, not as the empty shell of a Titan. She hears the sound of having returned through the cloth of the scarf. The people around see the face that hears it as close to madness. She does not explain the misunderstanding they see. In place of an explanation, she nods once to Armin.

segments.en: Jean does not lower the blade completely. The reason he does not lower it is that even if the shield is proof of an ally, the next instant can crush headquarters. He, having seen the power that can crush, does not put the hope of tenth place into his mouth today. In place of putting it there, he holds the position on the roof to the death. The eyes that hold it are looking at Eren's missing arm. The arm they are looking at is the one lost in the first battle. A lost friend comes back from inside a Titan. He holds the story of coming back with a wish to believe and a duty not to believe.
